_doc: Lumber loop knowledge (docs/LUMBER_LOOP.md). Every value comes from the user's demonstration capture logs/session_20260929_204225 (loop_mine.py timeline) and is pinned by harness/test_loop_demo.py. Serials are Test Shard, TestWorth, Shelter Island. Where a trip starts and ends (home landing, rental room, chest) is per character in harness/data/homes.json, not here (user decision 2026-10-04: no bank, boards into the rental room's chest).

vendor.buy_ok_text: The total of thy purchase is 5 gold.  My thanks for the patronage.

harvest.use_tool: Smart Harvest: dclick the equipped hatchet, answer its cursor with yourself (object target on our serial, our tile, our body). The demo targeted the tree instead (location target, static graphic)
harvest.success_text: You chop some logs and put them in your backpack.
nothing_near_texts: You do not see any harvestable resources nearby.
You cannot produce any wood from that.
harvest.nothing_near_source: capture 20261001_214649 at 23:27 (Hackworth, self-target at 1918,2612): the system line, then the second one overhead from ourselves; pinned by test_loop_lumber.py unit_capture_smart_harvest

area.note: Shelter Island (Young may harvest in town). Candidates are tree statics from map0.uoo; harvest memory learns which ones answer, run dry or can't be reached.

convert.use_tool: dclick the hatchet, target the log stack
convert.ok_text: You shape the logs into boards.
convert.note: logs and boards weigh the same (0.025 st, per-stack ceiling in the status weight); convert once per stack

deed.use: dclick a blank commodity, target the board stack
deed.prompt_text: What resource to you wish to create a commodity for?
deed.too_few_text: Commodity for that item must be of at least 5000.

travel_lockout.text_prefix: You have recently traveled and must wait

captcha.submit_button: random per captcha: 594 in the demo, 843 live 2026-09-29; the one reply button besides guide_button (last in the layout)
captcha.decoy_gumps: every harvest attempt also opens a gump with lines ['Captcha','Guide','Type the Value','Click when complete'], a random gump id, no buttons, offscreen text, noclose/nodispose. Never reply to it; detect the real captcha by gump id + text entry + a reply button besides guide_button, never by text or a fixed button id.
